question: What is the compound interest for 1 year on a sum of Rs.18000 at the annual rate of 20 percent per annum compounding half yearly?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **half-yearly compounding**, the rate becomes half (20% ÷ 2 = 10%) and time doubles (1 year × 2 = 2 periods).

Effective percentage for 2 periods at 10% = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100 = **21%**.

Compound Interest = 21% of ₹18000 = 18000 × 0.21 = ₹3780.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3780.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Principal (P) = ₹18000, Annual Rate (R) = 20%, Time (T) = 1 year, Compounded **Half-Yearly**.

**Formula Used:** Amount (A) = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ; Compound Interest (CI) = A − P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7804d684aa3f5661359881f2bf45c7e3fe9ff1acfc742d570c610e8dfb255aa.png] 

⇒ For half-yearly compounding, new rate (r) = 20% ÷ 2 = 10% per half-year.

⇒ Total periods (n) = 1 year × 2 = 2 half-years.

⇒ A = 18000 × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ A = 18000 × (11/10) × (11/10)

⇒ A = 18000 × 1.21 = ₹21780.

⇒ CI = A − P = 21780 − 18000 = ₹3780.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3780.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Half-Yearly Compounding Rule

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the annual rate is divided by 2 and the time is multiplied by 2.

Effective Rate Formula

For two successive changes of x% and y%, the net change is (x + y + xy/100)%. For 2 periods of 10% each, it is 21%.

Quarterly Compounding

In quarterly compounding, the rate is divided by 4 and the time is multiplied by 4 (n = 4T, r = R/4).
